p.src: 1  Israel, return to the LORD your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.

ja: イスラエルよ、あなたの
en: Israel, return to the LORD your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.
u.src: 1  Israel, return to the LORD your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.

p.src: 2  Take words with you, and return to the LORD. Tell him, “Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good; so we offer bulls as we vowed of our lips.

ja: を赦し、 良いものを
れてください。 そうすれば
で誓ったとおり雄牛をささげます。
en: Take words with you, and return to the LORD. Tell him, “Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good; so we offer bulls as we vowed of our lips.

p.src: 3  Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for in you the fatherless finds mercy.”

ja: わない。 みなしごは、あなたのもとであわれみを

p.src: 4  “I will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from them.

en: “I will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from them.

p.src: 5  I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.

ja: 私はイスラエルにとって
を咲かせ、 レバノンの
en: I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.

p.src: 6  His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.

ja: りはレバノンのようになる。
en: His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.
u.src: 6  His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.

en: Men will dwell in his shade. They will revive like the grain, and blossom like the vine. Their fragrance will be like the wine of Lebanon.
